stem.text: The equation shows that $\text{H}_2\text{(g)}$ and $\text{I}_2\text{(g)}$ react to form an equilibrium mixture.
A mixture containing equal amounts of $\text{H}_2\text{(g)}$ and $\text{I}_2\text{(g)}$ is made at temperature $T_1$ and the composition of the mixture is monitored. A graph of the results is shown.

stem.alt: Graph of mole fraction of I2(g) against time: starts at 0.5 at time 0, falls to a plateau at 0.23.

stem.text: The experiment is repeated at a lower temperature, $T_2$.
Which new graph would be obtained?

A.alt: Graph of mole fraction of I2(g) against time: starts at 0.5, falls gradually and levels off at 0.23.

B.alt: Graph of mole fraction of I2(g) against time: starts at 0.5, falls past 0.23 and levels off at about 0.1.

C.alt: Graph of mole fraction of I2(g) against time: starts at 0.5, falls steeply and levels off at 0.23.

D.alt: Graph of mole fraction of I2(g) against time: starts at 0.5, falls and levels off at about 0.4.
